Knight of Nurgle · Champion

Preview and download the Knight of Nurgle · Champion model for Warcraft 3. Add a plague-themed Warhammer Fantasy champion to your Warriors of Chaos army. Warriors of Chaos

There are many strange places to end up in the Old World...

Some would claim the strangest is tucked within the comforting embrace of the Urfather.

But why? What could drive mortal men to seek out something so wrong?

Tell me, what would a knight who has lost his family to war continue fighting for? What is left to endure for those whose martial strength proved meaningless against the plights of life?

The strongest men are not broken with swords... I can tell you that much.

It is there, in those dark corners of the mind you will hear him whisper to you.

His embrace, his promises...

No more restless nights. No more seeing faces long buried. No more graves to dig... no more watching those you once loved fade and turn to dust... no more fearing the years that seem to pass faster and faster.

He would take all the pain away.

He would tuck those memories gently to sleep, still the passing of time, and silence every wound that steel could never mend...

Such a watchful father.

A good father.

He does keep his promises.

The pain fades...

Then the feelings.

Then the memories.

Then flesh swells, old wounds open and blossom yet ache no more, flies gather beneath a rusted visor and the body slowly rots... but somehow refuses to die.

But from that warm, rotten embrace do those knights rise once again...

Perhaps to you they are disgusting abominations, bringers of death and decay, swollen, corpse-like and clad in rusted steel.

But in truth?

They have purpose.

They are at peace.

They are happy.

Are you?...
